description: How a PageSpec may reference tokens. Sections own their styling; a node's optional `tokens` object may only pick approved catalog ids for a closed set of slots. Enforced by schema/semantic_validate.py (TOKEN_* rules); categories are checked against tokens/llm/token-catalog.json by verify_all.py.

rawValueRestrictions.breakpoint: forbidden: reference a catalog token id instead
rawValueRestrictions.color: forbidden: reference a catalog token id instead
rawValueRestrictions.component: forbidden: reference a catalog token id instead
rawValueRestrictions.elevation: forbidden: reference a catalog token id instead
rawValueRestrictions.fontFamily: forbidden: reference a catalog token id instead
rawValueRestrictions.fontWeight: forbidden: reference a catalog token id instead
rawValueRestrictions.iconSize: forbidden: reference a catalog token id instead
rawValueRestrictions.layout: forbidden: reference a catalog token id instead
rawValueRestrictions.motion: forbidden: reference a catalog token id instead
rawValueRestrictions.radius: forbidden: reference a catalog token id instead
rawValueRestrictions.semantic: forbidden: reference a catalog token id instead
rawValueRestrictions.spacing: forbidden: reference a catalog token id instead
rawValueRestrictions.typography: forbidden: reference a catalog token id instead

rules.TOKEN_UNKNOWN: error: a slot value is not a token id in token-catalog.json
rules.TOKEN_RAW_COLOR: error: a raw hex / rgb() / rgba() / hsl() colour instead of a token id
rules.TOKEN_ARBITRARY_SPACING: error: a raw length (px/rem/em/%/vh/vw), bare number or calc() instead of a spacing/radius token id
rules.TOKEN_FONT_UNSUPPORTED: error: fontFamily is not one of the catalog fontFamily tokens (only font.family.national exists)
rules.TOKEN_SLOT_MISMATCH: error: a real token used in a slot whose policy does not allow its category / prefix (e.g. a foundation colour in `surface`, a text role as a surface)
rules.TOKEN_THEME_COMBINATION: error: the PageSpec theme is not a schema-validated theme in registry.manifest.json, or a semantic token is not resolved by that theme's file
rules.TOKEN_FONT_LICENCE: warn: font.family.national in generation mode; National 2 is licence-required, so a deployer without a Klim licence gets the Arial/Helvetica fallback

themes.note: The original ships no dark mode (0 prefers-color-scheme rules); any other theme value is TOKEN_THEME_COMBINATION.

overrides: Before 2.0.0 PageSpecs had no token field at all. 2.0.0 adds an OPTIONAL per-node `tokens` object restricted to the slots above, so token misuse is machine-checkable; omitting it keeps the section contract's own styling (all bundled examples except the token control omit or use it sparingly).
font: National 2 is licence-required (typography.font.family.national $extensions.licence). Generated output uses the fallback stack unless a licence is held.
reducedMotion: The source implements no prefers-reduced-motion handling (0 matches in src/ and the original CSS). reducedMotionFallback is a prescription for generated output, not a measured behaviour.
accessibilityNote: Known parity defects (non-keyboard-operable accordion and team rows, hamburger without aria-expanded, scroll lock persisting across the 768 resize) are documented as source-site behaviour in the section contracts. New builds generated from this repo should use button semantics and aria-expanded; that is a recommendation, not a description of the source.
